name: The Paul O'Grady Show
description: The Paul O'Grady Show is a British comedy chat show hosted by Birkenhead-born comedian Paul O'Grady. The format was originally devised by Granada Television and was broadcast on ITV before moving to Channel 4, where the show was produced by Olga TV. The programme is a teatime chat show consisting of a mixture of celebrity guests, comic stunts, musical performances, and occasionally viewer competitions.

videos.overview: Todays guests include Martine McCutcheon, the hostess of the recent 1st Annual Celebrity Awards on ITV1 and Jack Ellis who will discuss his role in a new children's series The Fugitives.
